about: Proposed collision for the helideck helicopter, in the map's box format (rig2_boxes.json: x east, y up, z south, metres). Valid for the placement below only. Not added to any map file.

place.local_to_map: map x = 7.5 + local x, map y = 13 + local z, map z = 27 - local y (nose = +x = east)

boxes.name: heli tail boom (1.6 m clear underneath: walk under it)
heli fin (stands over the west rail and net)
heli left sponson and main wheel (north side), 1.0 m high: low cover, can be climbed
heli right sponson and main wheel (south side)

non_blocking.name: main rotor disc: five stopped blades, 3.46 to 3.72 m above the deck, radius 5.7 m round map (7.5, 27). Above head height; leave without collision.
tail rotor (south face of the fin), lowest point 2.25 m above the deck

tie-down straps (four, from the sponsons to deck points at map (9.03, 22.1), (4.97, 22.1), (9.03, 31.9), (4.97, 31.9)), blade tie-down ropes, chocks, boarding steps, antennas, pitot tubes: no collision

conflicts_with_the_current_blockout: deck_locker.001 and its crouch box (min [6, 13, 26.2], max [8, 14.2, 27.8]) stand inside the fuselage: move or remove them.

box_yellow.008 with coiled_hose.010 (map x 9..11.5, z 21..22.2) covers the deck tie-down point at map (9.03, 22.1) that the front-left strap hooks into: move it at least 0.4 m east or north, or hide that strap.
